.claude/docs/workflow.md: This project uses a **reference-based** CLAUDE.md architecture — a thin CLAUDE.md index with deeper content in `.claude/docs/` (on-demand) and `.claude/rules/` (path-scoped). .claude/rules/ci.md: - 2026-10-13: A CI job that reads `cancelled` with no steps and no runner name never ran: read its cause from the check run's annotations (`gh api …/check-runs/<job id>/annotations`, e.g. "not acquired by Runner of type hosted"), since its log download answers 404, and re-run only that job (`gh run rerun <run> --failed`) to measure the leg.

.claude/rules/testing.md: - 2026-10-26: An OS-gated test module in product code stacks `#[cfg(test)]` first and the OS gate second, never one `#[cfg(all(test, …))]`: the Windows mutation-scope contract's `is_windows_gate` reads `cfg!(windows)` as well as `cfg(windows`, so a combined gate whose body holds `cfg!(windows)` ahead of the file's first `#[cfg(test)]` reads the file as Windows-gated product code; and a module whose every case is gated off an OS is gated whole, or its `use super::*` is an unused import that OS's lint fails on.
.claude/rules/verification-harness.md: - 2026-10-20: `target/debug/viola` is a hard link cargo re-points per feature set, so a `fake-agent` build between a live rig's setup and its start swaps the binary under it: read the build's hash right before the start, and restore a ledgered build by `ln -f` from its `target/debug/deps/` artifact.

.claude/rules/observability.md: - 2026-09-24: `obs_event!` expands to `::tracing::event!`, so a raw-log census greps `tracing::(info|warn|error|debug|trace)!` — a bare `tracing::` grep reads the sanctioned macro in `viola_core::obs` as a raw call.
